name: ctxwise
description: CtxWise: local-first context diagnostics, profiles, drift detection, and honest usage receipts.

interface.shortDescription: See what Codex carries before a task
interface.longDescription: Get an immediate local context snapshot, audit Codex sources, compile safe profiles, detect capability drift, create redacted lockfiles, and render post-turn usage receipts without sending data to another service. Distinct from the unrelated PyPI project named ctxray.
defaultPrompt: Show my immediate Codex context snapshot with CtxWise.
Create a lean Codex profile with CtxWise.
Explain my last CtxWise usage receipt.
